harness.name: SecGPT
harness.description: AutoGPT-style LLM tool for pentesting, vulnerability scanning and code audit, with CTF aims.

uses.quote: This part shows that SecGPT, based on the return of the previous command, made the second decision to call Sqlmap for detection.
Then, following this logic, it calls local plugin functions to attempt tasks such as website penetration, vulnerability scanning, code audit, and report writing.
SecGPT aims to make further contributions to network security by combining LLM, including penetration testing, red-blue confrontations, CTF competitions, and other aspects.
